mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points triggers a negative feedback loop where investors anticipate labor market weakening, leading to short-term S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses threshold, or Rank IC >0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 5-period moving averages signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both above their 5-period moving averages
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window despite both proxies above MA, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies investor confidence in long-term growth prospects, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above its 5-period moving average signals a strengthening labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS is above MA, or Rank IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 105.0 triggers investor optimism about excess capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO crosses threshold, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and labor costs (UNRATE) above their 5-period moving averages signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and UNRATE both above their 5-period moving averages
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window despite both proxies above MA, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an expanding demand cycle regime, a sustained increase in quarterly demand (GDPC1) above its 5-period moving average for 3 months amplifies growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In expanding demand cycle, 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 remains above MA for 3 months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.
